children: Broadcom (AVGO) shares climbed nearly 3% Tuesday as investors weighed a forecast calling for rapid expansion in the company's artificial intelligence chip business.

The semiconductor maker expects AI-related chip revenue to more than double in fiscal 2027 and increase again in fiscal 2028. Broadcom has become a major supplier of application-specific integrated circuits, or custom processors designed for particular workloads.

The outlook follows a strong fiscal second quarter. Revenue increased 48% from a year earlier to $22.2 billion, while net income advanced 88%. AI semiconductor sales grew at more than twice the pace of the overall business.

AI chips now account for more than 60% of Broadcom's revenue, giving the segment an increasing role in the company's financial results. Rising demand could also support margins, which already include a net profit margin above 40%.
Despite the business expansion, Broadcom has gained only about 6% in 2026, compared with a 13% advance for the S&P 500.
The stock trades at roughly 19 times forward earnings, leaving investors focused on whether upcoming results can support the company's aggressive AI growth expectations.

title: Broadcom Stock Jumps -- AI Revenue Set to Double Again
